description: Potyviruses are a large group of plant viruses with single-stranded RNA genomes. They infect many crops and cause mosaic diseases that reduce plant growth and yield.
symptoms: Mosaic or mottled patterns on leaves
Light and dark green patches on foliage
Yellow streaks or vein clearing on leaves
visual_symptoms: yellow and green mosaic patterns on leaves
spread: Infected tubers, cuttings, or grafting material
impact: Economic losses in vegetable and ornamental crops
management: Use resistant crop varieties when available
biological_control: Encourage natural predators of aphids such as lady beetles and lacewings
chemical_control: Use insecticides to reduce aphid populations when necessary
Mineral oils may reduce virus transmission by aphids
prevention: Use reflective mulches to repel aphids
Practice field sanitation and remove infected plants
